# sig.golf beta

Sig.golf is a Lean-certified competition for stateless hash-based signatures. The score is signature bytes times maximum honest RISC-V verification cycles.

Rules: /site/rules.html
Formal definitions: https://github.com/leanEthereum/sig.golf-dev/tree/beta
Submit by opening a PR against beta: https://github.com/leanEthereum/sig.golf-submissions/pulls
PR layout: https://github.com/leanEthereum/sig.golf-submissions/blob/beta/README.md

Verified results are published in /site/records.json.

Include presentation/ beside submission/ in every PR. Copy and customize:
- /site/examples/presentation-template/presentation.json
- /site/examples/presentation-template/scheme.svg

Explain the scheme briefly and draw its signature layout, encoding, authentication, and witness expansion.

Profile N accepting runs: samples=N; instructions={mnemonic: total}, with HALT=N; hashes={input_bits: total_calls}. Describe sampling in method. Submit integer totals, not averages; the site computes per-run counts and cycles.

Each file ≤64 KiB. SVG must be static, without scripts or external resources. Displayed as “Provided by submission · not verified”; no effect on scoring.
